chunks: And Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya and Ibn Abi Umayr from Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Mighty, 'And complete the Hajj and Umrah for Allah,' is it sufficient for a man, if he performs Tamattu' (Umrah followed by Hajj), to consider that Umrah in place of the separate Umrah (of Qiran or Tamattu')?
And complete the Hajj and Umrah for Allah
He (peace be upon him) said: 'Thus, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) commanded his companions.'

key_terms.تَمَتَّعَ: Performed Tamattu' (a type of Hajj where Umrah and Hajj are combined with a break in Ihram)
key_terms.مُفْرَدَة: Separate/Single (referring to a distinct, independent Umrah)

ai.seo_question: Does the Umrah performed during Hajj al-Tamattu' count as the required Umrah, or must a separate one be performed?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the legal validity of Hajj al-Tamattu' by confirming that the Umrah performed at the start of the season serves as the requisite single Umrah, eliminating the need for a separate one. This ruling is grounded in the prophetic precedent, reinforcing the structural integrity of the Tamattu' mode of pilgrimage as practiced by the Prophet's companions. The hadith highlights the practical ease granted to pilgrims while maintaining the essential components of the ritual.
